scope: Validate the fixed current-day fixture has one grain per student before the independent exact-microsecond oracle is used.

source.state: uncommitted incremental shared worktree; not final capacity acceptance

behavior: Post-drain raw observations must belong to fixture students, use the exact educational IXL page without teacher intent, have no current-day AI decisions and fit exactly one school-bound frozen session/expected class for their full observation range. Any violation is recorded as a fixed count and fails before the oracle or final worker. No actual aggregate is used to determine expected grains.
grainRationale: The generator always reports ixl.com/lesson, the classifier resolves it through the educational known list, SSO projection leaves it unchanged, and teacher intent is only added to non-educational results. The lifecycle sends Attention/Focus/cleanup commands but neither changes the frozen session nor the generated URL. Canonical preparation preserves existing captured_at values.
limits: Original combined04 failure is not reclassified as passed; exact raw observations were not retained.
This deliberately narrow fixture invariant is not a general multi-grain rollup oracle and cannot establish the correctness of every classification or roster case.
No product semantics, numeric tolerance, infrastructure or timeout changed. Capacity still requires fresh passing runs.
sanitation: User home paths, connection URLs and JWT-shaped values redacted. Output contains only fixed violation counts and synthetic case names.
